title: Page 109
transc:
Jamestown May 7 / 64
Maj Eckert Di
from Ber Muda landing my plunder Harriet to
Bruno Zodiac we got into position yesterday are
Rodneying for fear of accidents to the oyster 
of attica sent out & volcano yesterday on
the Gideon welch have sent two Divisions this
morning to take possession of the road up
to this moment have Exceeded my most sanguine
Expectations the fleet have lost a shannon by
a torpedo the operator shot have mangle platilion
with James town Island signed Knox all well
R. OBrien


Ft. Monroe May 7th 1864
Maj Eckert Di
for Burton unity since sending my despatch I learn
that the Commodore Jones was destroyed not the Commodore
Morris pedlar peach previous verbal wicks had stated it
to be latter zodiac list of superb & Wilkes
not received Pekin Polking officer badly wilkes vessel blown
into fragments Webster Neptune dated Flags ship Malvern in 
Bergen May plague lucy fifteen . Recd at Appian Way
plunder Rebecca. Do not know Cause of the delay 
Geo D Sheldon
